title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 09 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for IAF Agniveer Vayu (Science + Other than Science combined pattern). 100 Questions | 85 Minutes | English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Time: 85 minutes (official combined Science + Other than Science pattern).
Physics and Mathematics 10+2 CBSE level; English 10+2; RAGA includes Reasoning and GK/Defence.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: The squadron leader said, 'Prepare for night flying.'
The squadron leader said 'Prepare for night flying.'
The squadron leader said, Prepare for night flying.
The squadron leader said; 'Prepare for night flying.'
questions.explanation: A comma precedes a direct quotation and quotation marks enclose the spoken words.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change into passive: The technicians overhauled the afterburner assembly.
options: The afterburner assembly was overhauled by the technicians.
The afterburner assembly is overhauled by the technicians.
The afterburner assembly has overhauled the technicians.
The afterburner assembly had been overhauling by the technicians.
questions.explanation: Simple past active → was/were + past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said to the cadet, 'Have you completed the pre-flight check?'
options: He asked the cadet if he had completed the pre-flight check.
He told the cadet that he completed the pre-flight check.
He asked the cadet have you completed the pre-flight check.
He asked the cadet if he has completed the pre-flight check.
questions.explanation: Yes/no question in past reporting verb → asked + if + past perfect.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 26 January 2024 was a Friday, 15 August 2024 was a:
